channel.title: Search Engine Roundtable - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Search Engine Roundtable (seroundtable.com)

item.title: Bing Webmaster Tools AI Performance Reports Gain Grounding Queries and Pages Views
item.description: In February, Bing rolled out new AI Performance reports within Bing Webmaster Tools. Bing announced a new feature for this report that connects the Grounding Queries and Pages views within the AI Performance report.

item.title: Google Testing Reply To Reviews With Al
item.description: Google is testing encouraging business owners to reply to reviews using AI. There is a new option in the Google Business Profile dashboard that is showing for some businesses that says "Reply to reviews with AI."

item.title: Google AI Mode Tests Changing Some Links To Overlay Cards
item.description: Google is testing changing out some of the links within AI Mode to show as overlay cards, instead of take you directly to the website it is mentioning. This obviously will result in fewer direct clicks to those websites.

item.description: Here is a recap of what happened in the search forums today, through the eyes of the Search Engine Roundtable and other search forums on the web. Google AI Mode makes some links even worse. Google Personal Intelligence is looking to go global. Google is testing reply to reviews with AI. Bing Webmaster Tools AI performance report gains grounding queries to pages. Apple Maps may soon get ads...

item.title: Google Ads Performance Max Asset Group Theming
item.description: Google Ads is rolling out asset group theming for Performance Max campaigns. This lets you copy an asset group and apply this theme to your text and images using Google AI.

item.title: OpenAI ChatGPT Enables Location Sharing For More Localized Near Me Results
item.description: Last week, OpenAI announced a new feature for ChatGPT named location sharing. This allows you to share your precise location with ChatGPT, so ChatGPT can give you more localized and near me results.

item.title: Bing Search Ads Sponsored Label Almost Transparent
item.description: Microsoft is at it again with its sponsored labels tests. This time, Microsoft is testing almost transparent sponsored labels within the Bing search results. The labels are super grayed out and super hard to see.

item.title: Google On Why Core Updates Take Weeks To Roll Out
item.description: Google's John Mueller explained, one again, why it takes weeks to roll out a core update. It is often because there are different components to core updates through the rollout stages, and each needs to be pushed individually.

item.title: Daily Search Forum Recap: March 31, 2026

item.title: New: Microsoft Advertising Merchant Center Enables Store & Domain Name Updates
item.description: You can now update your store's name and / or domain name directly in Merchant Center within Microsoft Advertising.

item.title: Google Explains Googlebot Crawling, Fetching & Limits
item.description: Google posted a new blog post named Inside Googlebot: demystifying crawling, fetching, and the bytes we process alongside episode 105 of the Search Off the Record segment named Google crawlers behind the scenes.

item.title: Google's Ask Maps Fully Available In US and India
item.description: Earlier this month, Google rolled out the "Ask Maps" feature. Now, Google said it is "available to everyone in the U.S. and India."
